summary.en-US: Verify file integrity

description.en-US:
Hash Droid is a free utility to calculate a hash from a given text or from a file stored on the device.

In this application, the available hash functions are: Adler-32, CRC-32, Haval-128, MD2, MD4, MD5, RIPEMD-128, RIPEMD-160, SHA-1, SHA-256, SHA-384, SHA-512, Tiger and Whirlpool.
The calculated hash can be copied to the clipboard to be reused elsewhere.

The first tab enables to calculate the hash of a given string.
The second tab helps you to compute the hash of a file located on the internal or external memory of your device. The size of the file and the last date modified are also displayed.
The last feature helps you to compare the calculated hash with another given hash but more generally, you can compare any hashes by just pasting them.

A hash (also called checksum or digest) is a digital fingerprint, uniquely identifying a string or a file.
Hash functions are often used in cryptography to generate strong passwords. They are also employed to check the integrity of files.
Hash Droid is often used to check an Android ROM before flashing it.

* Start the Termux:Boot app once by clicking on its launcher icon.
* This allow the app to be run at boot.
* Create the ~/.termux/boot/ directory.
* Put scripts you want to execute inside the ~/.termux/boot/ directory.
* If there are multiple files, they will be executed in a sorted order.

Note that you may want to run termux-wake-lock as first thing want to ensure
that the device is prevented from sleeping.

Example: To start an sshd server and prevent the device from sleeping at boot,
create the a file ~/.termux/boot/start-sshd containing the line:

termux-wake-lock && sshd

description.en-US:
Opaque is a GPLv3 licensed secure, super fast oVirt, Red Hat Enterprise Virtualization (RHEV), and Proxmox VDI client that allows you to connect graphically to all your virtual machines running in the cloud from anywhere in the world. It currently implements support for the SPICE protocol.

NOTES
(1) Some older devices are known to have issues with self-signed SSL certificates. If you find you are affected, return Opaque or ask for a refund. Please do not rate the application badly because of a platform issue!

(2) On most current devices, playing sound and video exceeds the CPU processing power and causes jittery sound and video playback.

(3) If virtual machines are behind a RHEV/oVirt proxy, you may need to connect to them with Opaque by using a .vv file. To get a .vv file, you have to login through the oVirt/RHEV web interface and connect to your VM's console there. Chrome works perfectly with the web interface, and opens Opaque directly. With Firefox, you have to open a File Manager, and tap the file in the Downloads folder as soon as the download completes. The built-in Android Browser does not work for .vv downloading.
* System administrators: If you are planning to recommend this app, please ensure you have determined the simplest method of access for your environment.
* Users: If you're unsure, please ask your System Administrator!

(4) The oVirt web "User Portal" for oVirt v3.4 and older does not allow obtaining .vv files for virtual machines.

(5) Direct connections to Proxmox VMs are now fully supported. Select Proxmox from the Virtualization Environment drop-down when adding a connection (tap the "+" at the main screen).

Current features include:
- Full Proxmox and oVirt/RHEV integration.
- TFA / OTP Two factor authentication with Proxmox (Yubikey, Google Authenticator, etc.)
- Android 4.x and earlier: USB redirection with OTG enabled devices. Connect your OTG cable prior to connecting to your VM. For some Android 4.x and Android 5.0 and later, your device must be rooted and you have to use "SELinux Mode Changer" (from Google Play) to set selinux to permissive mode.
- Audio playback/recording
- Supports both Proxmox and oVirt/RHEV virt-viewer/remote-viewer (.vv) files
- Ability to edit default settings for .vv file connections or to make creation of new connections more convenient (on the main app page, tap the wrench at the top-right corner or look in the menu on older devices).
- SSL encryption for peace of mind
- Commercially signed and self-signed certificates
- SPICE protocol support
- Automatic rotation
- Desktop resizing to match display resolution
- Pinch-zoom
- Multi-touch UI with four mouse input modes to choose from
- Mouse scrolling by swiping with two fingers up/down
- Single-handed mode for easy on-the-go operation
- Support for most bluetooth input devices.

Planned features:
- Allocating VMs from a pool
- Clipboard integration
- VNC protocol support

Opaque source code is GPLv3 licensed, and is available here:
https://github.com/iiordanov/remote-desktop-clients

It also uses a number of open-source libraries included in the Gstreamer SDK for Android, as well as libcelt, openssl, libgovirt, jpeg-turbo, and librest.

This app is built and signed by Kali NetHunter.

description.de:
Klicken Sie einfach auf einen Link, der auf einen Standort zeigt und LocationPrivacy wird als eine der Optionen angezeigt. Wenn Sie es auswählen, dann wird es die bestmögliche datengeschützte Methode nutzen, um den Standort von diesem Link zu erhalten. Der Standort wird dann an die von Ihnen gewählte Karten-App weitergeleitet. LocationPrivacy ist keine wirkliche App, sondern eher eine Reihe von "Datenschutzfiltern" für all die verschiedenen Verfahren der Standortfreigabe. Wenn Sie in einer App auf einen Standortverweis klicken, bietet sich LocationPrivacy als Option an. Es erkennt dann unsichere Methoden der Standortfreigabe und konvertiert sie dann in die am meisten datengeschützten verfügbaren Methoden. Bei vielen Links kann der Standort abgefragt werden, ohne überhaupt online zu sein. Bei anderen fragt LocationPrivacy über Tor den Standort von der Webseite ab, so dass er nicht zu Ihnen verfolgt werden kann. Wenn immer möglich, verwendet die Verbindung HTTPS.

OsmAnd ist die empfohlene Karten-App für den datengeschützten Standort, da sie vollständig offline arbeitet und wir sie geprüft haben. LocationPrivacy funktioniert grundsätzlich mit allen Kartenanwendungen. LocationPrivacy kann auch als Möglichkeit dienen, alle Standortlinks an Ihre bevorzugte Mapping-App umzuleiten. Alle Map-Apps in Android können `geo:`URIs anzeigen, und LocationPrivacy konvertiert viele Arten von Links in `geo:`URIs, einschließlich: Google Maps, OpenStreetMap, Amap, Baidu Map, QQ Map, Nokia HERE, Yandex Maps.

Dies ist immer noch eine Beta-Version einer neuen Idee, wenn Sie Probleme oder Ideen haben, posten Sie sie bitte in unserem Issue Tracker, damit wir diese App verbessern können!

Just click on a link that points to a location, and LocationPrivacy will show up as one of the options. If you select it, then it will use the most private way possible to get the location from that link. It will then forward the location to the map app that you choose. LocationPrivacy is not really app but rather a set of "privacy filters" for all of the various ways of sharing location. When you click on a location link in one app, LocationPrivacy offers itself as an option. It then recognizes insecure methods of sharing location, and then converts them to the most private methods available. For many links, the location can be read without even going online. For others, LocationPrivacy reads the location from the webpage via Tor, so that it cannot be tracked to you. Whenever possible, the connection uses HTTPS.

OsmAnd is the recommended map app for private location because it works fully offline and we have audited it. LocationPrivacy will work with basically all map apps. LocationPrivacy can also serve as a way to redirect all location links to your favorite mapping app. All map apps in Android can view `geo:` URIs, and LocationPrivacy converts many kinds of links to `geo:` URIs, including: Google Maps, OpenStreetMap, Amap, Baidu Map, QQ Map, Nokia HERE, Yandex Maps.

description.en-US:
Orfox is built from the same source code as Tor Browser (which is built upon Firefox), but with a few minor modifications to the privacy enhancing features to make them compatible with Firefox for Android and the Android operating system.

Orfox REQUIRES Orbot app for Android to connect to the Tor network.

In as many ways as possible, we adhere to the design goals of Tor Browser (https://www.torproject.org/projects/torbrowser/design/), by supporting as much of their actual code as possible, and extending their work into the additional Android components of Firefox for Android.

** Also, includes NoScript and HTTPSEverywhere add-ons built in!

The Tor software protects you by bouncing your communications around a distributed network of relays run by volunteers all around the world: it prevents somebody watching your Internet connection from learning what sites you visit, it prevents the sites you visit from learning your physical location, and it lets you access sites which are blocked.

Learn more at:
https://guardianproject.info/apps/orfox

* * How is Orfox different than Tor Browser for desktop?

* The Orfox code repository is at https://github.com/guardianproject/tor-browser and the Tor Browser repository is here:https://gitweb.torproject.org/tor-browser.git/. The Orfox repository is a fork of the Tor Browser repository with the necessary modification and Android-specific code as patches on top of the Tor Browser work. We will keep our repository in sync with updates and release of Tor Browser.

* Orfox is built from the Tor Browser repo based on ESR38 (https://dev.guardianproject.info/issues/5146https://dev.guardianproject.info/news/221) and has only two modified patches that were not relevant or necessary for Android

* Orfox does not currently include the mobile versions of the Tor Browser * Button, but this we will be added shortly, now that we have discovered how to properly support automatic installation of extensions on Android (https://dev.guardianproject.info/issues/5360)

* Orfox currently allows for users to bookmark sites, and may have additional data written to disk beyond what the core gecko browser component does. We are still auditing all disk write code, and determining how to appropriately disable or harden it. (https://dev.guardianproject.info/issues/5437)

* * How is Orfox different than Orweb?

Orweb is our current default browser for Orbot/Tor mobile users (https://guardianproject.info/apps/orweb) that has been downloaded over 2 million times. It is VERY VERY SIMPLE, as it only has one tab, no bookmark capability, and an extremely minimal user experience.

Orweb is built upon the bundled WebView (Webkit) browser component inside of the Android operating system. 
This has proven to be problematic because we cannot control the version of that component, and cannot upgrade it directly when bugs are found. In addition, Google has made it very difficult to effectively control the network proxy settings of all aspects of this component, making it difficult to guarantee that traffic will not leak on all devices and OS versions.

Orweb also only provides a very limited amount of capability of Tor Browser, primarily related to reducing browser fingerprinting, minimizing disk writes, and cookie and history management. It trys to mimic some of the settings of Tor Browser, but doesn’t actually use any of the actual code written for Tor Browser security hardening.

description.de-DE:
Ripple ist ein "Panikknopf", der seine Triggernachricht an jede App senden kann, die ein "Panik-Responder" ist.  Solche Apps können Dinge tun wie sich sperren, sich verbergen, private Daten löschen, eine Notfallnachricht senden und mehr.  Es ist für Situationen gedacht, in denen Zeit zu reagieren bleibt, Benutzer aber sicher sein müssen, es nicht versehentlich auszulösen.

Dies ist eine BETA-Version dieser App!  Wir arbeiten jetzt gerade daran, die Unterstützung möglichst vieler weiterer Apps zu ergänzen.  ChatSecure, Orweb, Umbrella und Zom werden bereits unterstützt, diese Apps kommen in Kürze hinzu: Courier, PanicButton, OpenKeychain, Orfox, SMSSecure, StoryMaker.

Hier sind zwei Beispielszenarien:

* Bei einer Organisation werden regelmäßig Razzien durch Sicherheitskräfte durchgeführt, die alle Computer und mobilen Geräte auf dem Gelände durchsuchen. Die Organisation hat in der Regel mindestens ein oder zwei Minuten Vorwarnzeit, bevor eine Razzia beginnt. Sie benötigen eine sehr zuverlässige Methode, um das Löschen aller Daten aus den sensiblen Anwendungen auszulösen.

* Eine Entwicklungshelferin hat viele sensible Daten über Personen auf seinem Gerät.  Sie synchronisieren diese Daten regelmäßig mit einer sicheren, zentralen Datenbank.  Gelegentlich muss die Helferin das Land sehr kurzfristig verlassen.  Die Grenzschutzbeamten laden regelmäßig den gesamten Inhalt mobiler Geräte von Durchreisenden herunter.  Während sie an der Grenze in der Schlange steht, sieht die Entwicklungshelferin, wie die Grenzschutzbeamten die Geräte der Menschen beschlagnahmen und erinnert sich dann an alle Daten auf dem Gerät, also entsperrt sie das Telefon und drückt den Auslöser, der alle empfindlichen Anwendungen von dem Gerät löscht. Wenn die Helferin in die Zentrale zurückkehrt, wird das Gerät wieder mit der zentralen Datenbank synchronisiert.

description.en-US:
Ripple is a "panic button" that can send it's trigger message to any app that is a "panic responder".  Such apps can do things like lock, disguise themselves, delete private data, send an emergency message, and more.  It is meant for situations where there is time to react, but where users need to be sure it is not mistakenly set off.

This is a BETA version of this app!  We are working now to add support to as many other apps as possible.  ChatSecure, Orweb, Umbrella, and Zom already have support, these apps are coming soon: Courier, PanicButton, OpenKeychain, Orfox, SMSSecure, StoryMaker.

Here are two example scenarios:

* An organization gets regularly raided by the security forces, who search all of the computers and mobile devices on the premises. The organization usually has at least a minute or two of warning before a raid starts. They need a very reliable way to trigger wiping all of the data from the sensitive apps.

* An aid worker has lots of sensitive data about people on their device.  They regularly sync that data to a secure, central database.  Occasionally, the aid worker has to leave the country on very short notice.  The border guards regularly download the entire contents of mobile devices of people crossing through.  While waiting in line at the border, the aid worker sees the border guards seizing people's devices, and then remembers all the data on the device, so she unlocks the phone and hits the wipe trigger, which wipes all sensitive apps from the device. When the aid worker returns to the central office, the device is again synced up with the central database.

This project was started as part of the T2 Panic work.  Read more about it here:
https://guardianproject.info/tag/panic

description.es-ES:
Ripple es un "botón de pánico" que puede enviar su mensaje de activación a cualquier aplicación que sea un "respondedor de pánico".  Tales aplicaciones pueden hacer cosas como bloquear, disfrazarse, eliminar datos privados, enviar un mensaje de emergencia, y más.  Está pensado para situaciones en las que hay tiempo para reaccionar, pero donde los usuarios necesitan estar seguros de que no se activa por error.

Esta es una versión BETA de esta aplicación!  Estamos trabajando ahora para agregar soporte a tantas otras aplicaciones como sea posible.  ChatSecure, Orweb, Umbrella y Zom ya tienen soporte, estas aplicaciones están próximamente: Courier, PanicButton, OpenKeychain, Orfox, SMSSecure, StoryMaker.

Aquí hay dos escenarios de ejemplo:

* Una organización es asaltada regularmente por las fuerzas de seguridad, que buscan en todos los ordenadores y dispositivos móviles en las instalaciones. La organización suele tener al menos un minuto o dos de advertencia antes de que comience una incursión. Necesitan una forma muy confiable de activar la limpieza de todos los datos de las aplicaciones confidenciales.

* Un trabajador de ayuda tiene una gran cantidad de datos sensibles sobre las personas en su dispositivo.  Sincronizan regularmente esos datos con una base de datos central y segura.  Ocasionalmente, el trabajador humanitario tiene que abandonar el país con muy poca antelación.  Los guardias fronterizos descargan regularmente todo el contenido de los dispositivos móviles de las personas que cruzan.  Mientras espera en la fila en la frontera, el trabajador de ayuda ve a los guardias fronterizos apoderarse de los dispositivos de las personas, y luego recuerda todos los datos en el dispositivo, por lo que desbloquea el teléfono y golpea el disparador de borrado, que borra todas las aplicaciones sensibles del dispositivo. Cuando el trabajador de ayuda vuelve a la oficina central, el dispositivo se sincroniza de nuevo con la base de datos central.

description.hi-IN:
रिपल एक "पैनिक बटन" है जो किसी भी ऐप पर ट्रिगर संदेश भेज सकता है जो "पैनिक रिस्पॉन्डर" है। इस तरह के ऐप लॉक, खुद को छिपाने, निजी डेटा को हटाने, एक आपातकालीन संदेश भेजने, और बहुत कुछ जैसे काम कर सकते हैं। यह उन स्थितियों के लिए है जहां प्रतिक्रिया करने का समय है, लेकिन जहां उपयोगकर्ताओं को यह सुनिश्चित करने की आवश्यकता है कि यह गलती से बंद नहीं है।

यह इस ऐप का एक बीटा वर्जन है! हम संभव के रूप में कई अन्य एप्लिकेशन के लिए समर्थन जोड़ने के लिए अब काम कर रहे हैं। ChatSecure, Orweb, Umbrella, और Zom को पहले से ही सपोर्ट है, ये ऐप्स जल्द ही आ रहे हैं: Courier, PanicButton, OpenKeychain, Orfox, SMSSecure, StoryMaker।

यहाँ दो उदाहरण परिदृश्य हैं:

Ripple è un "pulsante antipanico" che può inviare il un messaggio di attivazione a qualsiasi app che sia da "antipanico". È pensato per le situazioni in cui c'è il tempo di reagire, ma in cui gli utenti devono essere sicuri che non sia impostato per errore.

Questa è una versione BETA di questa app! Ora stiamo lavorando per aggiungere supporto a quante più app possibile. ChatSecure, Orweb, Umbrella e Zom hanno già il supporto, queste app saranno presto disponibili: Courier, PanicButton, OpenKeychain, Orfox, SMSSecure, StoryMaker.

Ecco due scenari di esempio:

* Un'organizzazione viene regolarmente assalita dalle forze di sicurezza, che effettuano ricerche in tutti i computer e dispositivi mobili locali. L'organizzazione di solito ha almeno un minuto o due di preavviso prima dell'inizio di un raid. Hanno bisogno di un modo molto affidabile per attivare la cancellazione di tutti i dati dalle app sensibili.

* Un operatore umanitario ha molti dati sensibili relativi alle persone sul proprio dispositivo. Sincronizzano regolarmente quei dati con un database centrale sicuro. Occasionalmente, gli operatori umanitari devono lasciare il Paese con un preavviso molto breve. "Кнопка паніки" Ripple це кнопка, яка може надіслати повідомлення про тригер будь-якому застосунку, який є "панічною відповіддю". Такі застосунки можуть робити такі речі, як блокування, маскування, видалення особистих даних, надсилання екстреного повідомлення тощо. Він призначений для ситуацій, коли є час на реакцію, але коли користувачі повинні бути впевнені, що це не помилково відкладено.

Це БЕТА версія цього застосунку! Зараз ми працюємо над тим, щоб додати підтримку якомога більше інших застосунків. У ChatSecure, Orweb, Umbrella та Zom вже є підтримка, незабаром з’являються такі застосунки: Courier, PanicButton, OpenKeychain, Orfox, SMSSecure, StoryMaker.

Ось два приклади сценаріїв:

* Організації регулярно проводять рейди з боку силовиків, які обшукують усі комп'ютери та мобільні пристрої в приміщеннях. Організація зазвичай має принаймні хвилину або дві попередження до початку рейду. Їм потрібен дуже надійний спосіб активувати витирання всіх даних із чутливих додатків.

* Спеціаліст має безліч конфіденційних даних про людей на своєму пристрої. Вони регулярно синхронізують ці дані із захищеною центральною базою даних. Іноді, працівникові служби доводиться виїжджати з країни дуже хутко. Прикордонники регулярно завантажують весь вміст мобільних пристроїв людей, які перетинають. Поки чекає в черзі на кордоні, працівник служби допомоги бачить прикордонників, що захоплюють пристрої людей, а потім запам'ятовує всі дані на пристрої, тож вона розблоковує телефон і натискає на спусковий гачок, який витирає всі чутливі застосунки з пристрою. Коли працівник служби допомоги повертається до центрального офісу, пристрій знову синхронізується з центральною базою даних.

description.en-US:
Bale is a financial and social messaging application developed by Bank Melli Iran, designed to facilitate communication and banking services seamlessly. Available for the Android platform, users can download Bale to enjoy a blend of chat features and financial transactions within a single interface.

The app allows users to send various types of messages, including text, voice, video, and images. This versatility enables users to maintain personal connections and share multimedia content with family and friends easily. Bale also supports the creation of diverse channels, which can focus on news, entertainment, sports, and other topics, fostering community engagement and information sharing.

Users can establish groups with a capacity of up to 2,048 members, making it suitable for large communities or organizations. Bale provides options for creating both private and public channels, which can be utilized for content dissemination, business promotions, and charity initiatives. This feature encourages users to engage with a broader audience while promoting their interests or causes.

In addition to messaging capabilities, Bale includes a unique bot feature that enables users to create automated tools for various tasks, including financial transactions. This integration of bots simplifies processes, allowing for efficient management of tasks within the app. The platform also supports sticker creation, giving users the opportunity to personalize their communication experience with custom stickers.

Bale is not limited to messaging; it also offers a range of financial services. One of its notable functions is the ability to perform card-to-card transfers among banks participating in the Shetab network without needing the recipient's card number. Users simply need to mention the bank's name, streamlining the transfer process significantly.

The app supports the National Bank of Iran’s digital wallet, known as Jibam, providing users with easy access to a variety of banking services. This integration allows for actions such as opening accounts, managing loans, checking balances, and even seeking online banking advice without the necessity of visiting a physical branch.

Furthermore, Bale facilitates the purchase and sale of content, enabling users to buy internet packages, recharge their phones, and pay utility bills directly through the application. Users can pay for mobile, fixed-line, electricity, water, and gas bills, providing a comprehensive solution for managing their financial obligations.

The app also allows users to view their account balances and transaction history without incurring additional fees. This transparency helps users keep track of their financial activities more effectively. Additionally, the ability to request money linked to a bank card number is particularly useful for invoicing, charity collections, and other financial transactions.

Bale provides support for multiple languages, including Persian, Turkish, Arabic, and English, making it accessible to a wider audience. This multilingual capability ensures that users from different backgrounds can navigate the app and utilize its features comfortably.

For vehicle owners, Bale includes features for paying toll fees, traffic violation fines, and insurance premiums through its dedicated bot services. This integration simplifies the payment process for essential services, making it efficient and straightforward for users to manage their vehicle-related expenses.

The app's web version allows users to access their messages and perform banking tasks from a computer or laptop, offering flexibility in how users interact with the application. This multi-device support enables seamless transitions between devices, ensuring that users can stay connected and manage their finances conveniently.

With the night mode option, users can reduce eye strain during evening hours, enhancing their overall experience while using the app. The ability to access the application across different devices means that users can remain connected, whether they are using a mobile phone, tablet, or computer.

Bale combines the features of a social networking platform with practical banking services, making it a versatile tool for users in Iran. By integrating communication and financial management, the app caters to the diverse needs of its users, promoting ease of use and efficiency in daily transactions.

The multifaceted nature of Bale allows it to cater to various user needs, whether for personal communication or managing finances. The app's continuous updates and enhancements reflect its commitment to improving user experience and expanding its service offerings, ensuring that it remains relevant in the rapidly evolving digital landscape.

The features of Bale encapsulate a modern approach to financial transactions and social interaction, making it an essential app for individuals looking to simplify their communication and banking needs in one convenient location.

phone into a motion, sound, vibration and light detector, watching

generously provided by FoPF, and donations to support continuing work
can be contributed through their site:
https://freedom.press/donate-support-haven-open-source-project

Safety through Sensors

and stores everything locally on the device. You can position the
device’s camera to capture visible motion, or set your phone
somewhere discreet to just listen for noises. Get secure
notifications of intrusion events instantly and access the logs
remotely or anytime later.

The follow sensors are monitored for a measurable change, and then
recorded to an event log on the device:

* Accelerometer: phone’s motion and vibration
* Camera: motion in the phone’s visible surroundings from front or back camera
* Microphone: noises in the enviroment
* Light: change in light from ambient light sensor

description.en-US:
ProofMode is light, minimal "reboot" of our full encrypted, verified secure camera app, CameraV (https://guardianproject.info/apps/camerav). Our hope was to create a lightweight, almost invisible utility, that you can run all of the time on your phone, that automatically extra digital proof data to all photos and videos you take. This data can then be easily shared through a "Share Proof" share action, to anyone you choose.

ProofMode is an open-source project. Learn more at https://proofmode.org

Goals

* Run all of the time in the background without noticeable battery, storage or network impact
* Provide a no-setup-required, automatic new user experience that works without requiring training
* Use strong cryptography for strong identity and verification features, but not encryption
* Produce "proof" data formats that can be easily parse, imported by existing tools (CSV)
* Do not modify the original media files; all proof metadata storied in separate file
* Support both full "proof" data generation, as well as more simple sha1/sha256 hash and PGP signature of media files
* Do not require a persistent identity or account generation

Contributions

* Some icons were used under the APL 2.0 license from the Google Material Design Icon library: https://material.io/icons/
* The App Intro library is used under the APL 2.0 license: https://github.com/paolorotolo/AppIntro
* Spongy Castle uses the same adaptation of the MIT X11 License as Bouncy Castle.: https://rtyley.github.io/spongycastle/

NOTICE: Work on ProofMode is active and underway, however there has not yet been a full technical, security, or legal audit. The proofmode metadata and cryptographic chain-of-custody have not yet been tested in court or other legal proceedings.

NonFreeComp.en-US: ProofMode uses a number of proprietary Google Play Services libraries, such as Play Integrity (SafetyNet), FusionLocationProvider and others, to provide extra assurances about the provenance of media files generated on an Android device.

In einer Welt voller viraler Videos und der Gesichtserkennung hilft Ihnen ObscuraCam, Bilder und Videos zu teilen und gleichzeitig die Privatsphäre aller Beteiligten zu schützen. Mit ObscuraCam können Sie Gesichter in Bildern und Videos verfälschen. Als zusätzliche Sicherheit werden Informationen, die Sie als den Kameramann identifizieren könnten, aus den Dateien gelöscht.

* DATENSCHUTZ FÜR IHRE BILDER: ObscuraCam kann als Kamera verwendet werden, um Fotos zu machen oder um bereits aufgenommene Bilder zu anonyminisieren.
* SICH SELBST TARNEN: Gesichter verpixeln, schwärzen oder mit lustigen Nasen und Brillen versehen.
* AUTOMATISCHE GESICHTSERKENNUNG: ObscuraCam erkennt Gesichter automatisch in Fotos und Videos. So können einfach Gruppen oder lange Videos anonymisiert werden.
* VERSCHIEDENE DATENSCHUTZMODI: Gesichter können verpixelt, entfernt oder mit komischen Nasen und Brillen verfremdet werden. Es kann auch alles außer einem kleinen Bildausschnitt verfremdet werden.
* SICHERES TEILEN: Wir entfernen alle in Fotodateien enthaltenen Identitätsdaten wie GPS-Koordinaten und das Handymodell. Die Bilder könnnen dann wieder in der Galerie gespeichert oder direkt zu Facebook, Twitter und allen anderen "Teilen"-Apps hochgeladen werden.
* SCHÜTZT DIE IDENTITÄT DES FOTOGRAFEN: Smartphones hängen Informationen an jedes Foto, das sie aufnehmen, einschließlich wo das Foto entstanden ist und mit welcher Kamera. OscuraCam entfernt all diese Informationen.
* AUSGEZEICHNET: ObscuraCam war der Gewinner der Knights News Challenge 2013.

Em um mundo de vídeos virais e reconhecimento facial o ObscuraCam ajuda você a compartilhar fotos e vídeos ao mesmo tempo que protege a sua privacidade e daqueles que você gosta. Com o ObscuraCam é possível desfocar e disfarçar os rostos nas suas fotos e vídeos. Informações que podem identificá-lo como o operador de câmera são removidas dos arquivos para uma melhor segurança

* PRIVACIDADE PARA AS SUAS FOTOS: O ObscuraCam pode ser usado como uma câmera para tirar fotos ou para tornar anônimas as fotos e os vídeos que você já tirou
* DISFARCE-SE: Cubra os rostos com pixels, edite (escureça) ou faça um nariz e óculos engraçados
* DETECÇÃO FACIAL AUTOMÁTICA: O ObscuraCam detecta automaticamente os rostos nas fotos e nos vídeos para que você possa anonimizar de forma rápida e eficiente um público ou um vídeo de longa duração
* DIVERSOS MODOS DE PRIVACIDADE: Os rostos podem ser pixelizados, removidos completamente ou disfarçados com um nariz ou óculos engraçados. Você pode também desfocar tudo, exceto uma pequena parte de uma imagem
* COMPARTILHE DE FORMA SEGURA: Removemos todos os dados de identificação que estão armazenados nas fotos, incluindo os dados de localização GPS, marca e modelo do telefone para que você possa salvar a foto protegida na Galeria ou compartilhá-la diretamente no Facebook, Twitter ou qualquer outro aplicativo que tenha a opção "Compartilhar"
* PROTEGE A IDENTIDADE DO FOTÓGRAFO: Os smartphones anexam informações em todas as fotos que tiram, incluindo de onde foram tiradas e de que tipo de câmera. ObscuraCam remove todas estas informações
* PREMIADO: A ObscuraCam foi o vencedor do prêmio Knight News Challenge em 2013
